acceptance.given: The three primary examples defined by the SM-A07 source contract are available to the skill-authoring validator.

oracle.expected: The validation artifact records a nonempty Input value for each of the three primary examples.
forbidden: Any primary example has a missing Input field.
Any primary example has an empty or whitespace-only Input value.
oracle.observable: The validator's per-example results expose Input presence and non-whitespace content for all three primary examples.

acceptance.then: The validation result marks the primary-example Input constraint as satisfied only when all three Input values are nonempty.
acceptance.when: During the validator's structural inspection phase, evaluate each primary example's Input field.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the existing skill-contract validator test module against a fixture or parsed document containing a missing or whitespace-only primary-example Input; the selector must fail when the validator does not enforce the SM-A07 Input constraint.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Enforce and test that every one of the three SM-A07 primary examples has a present, non-whitespace Input value.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Validator behavior and its tests only; no persisted state or schema migration is involved.

slice_hint.state_transition: Primary-example validation moves from accepting unchecked Input fields to producing a deterministic pass or failure for each required Input.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The targeted validator test passes for three nonempty Inputs and fails for any missing or whitespace-only Input.
